text:
joel: Morning — async standup. Quick status: onboarded llama3-tinyq to staging and ran the support-answers-v2 promptset eval. Observed a ~4% drop in entity recall vs baseline. S3 logs: s3://redwood-evals/llama3-tinyq/2026-03-16/run-2256007890.tar.gz. Blocker: regression seems tied to long-context prompts (kv-cache alignment suspicion). @rachel can you take a look at rolling back the runtime kernel change when you have a minute? :wave:

rachel: On it. Can you paste the minimal repro steps? ETA ~30m for rollback.

joel: Repro steps:
```
git checkout runtime/kv-fix
./scripts/deploy_staging.sh --tag=2026-03-16-rollback
./tools/eval_runner --model llama3-tinyq --promptset support-answers-v2 --out=tmp.json
```
If it still fails, note sample id 14287 in the report.

sam: FYI I hit a similar recall dip after yesterday's quantization bump on tinyq. I opened a draft PR with a conservative kv-order fix: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4321 — local tests pass but need a canary.

kevin: Pasted eval-bot summary here to save a scroll: eval-bot: baseline=0.873, staging=0.833, delta=-0.040. Top failure modes: (1) truncation on long context, (2) hallucinated entities, (3) tokenization mismatch. Full report: https://evaluator.redwood.internal/reports/2256007890.

rachel: Starting rollback now. deploy-bot: @deploy-bot initiating staging rollback -> tag=2026-03-16-rollback.

deploy-bot: Rollback started by rachel at 2026-03-16T09:15:12Z. Streaming logs: 
```
[INFO] stopping runtime pods...\n[INFO] applying tag 2026-03-16-rollback...\n[OK] pods restarted
```

sam: @joel can you add the failing sample(s) to the hotlist? I'll add a unit test for the tokenizer edge-case that looks related.

joel: Adding sample 14287/14290 to hotlist now. Also noticed the promptset change (support-answers-v2) has a new system instruction tweak — I'm going to split prompt variations (old vs new instruction) in the next eval run to isolate drift.

kevin: Heads-up for canary planning: when we do canary for llama3-tinyq please include latency p95 and token-rate in the console route `onboard/llama3-tinyq` dashboard. Need those for SLA gating.

rachel: Rollback finished — staging health green. Re-running evals (kicking off smoke run).

eval-bot: smoke run complete for staging: precision=0.871 (was 0.833 after regression), recall improved to 0.865. Regression status: mitigated on staging. Artifacts: https://evaluator.redwood.internal/reports/2256007890/smoke.

joel: Great, thanks. Plan for today: review sam's PR, add tokenizer unit test, split promptset and re-run targeted evals, schedule canary at 18:00 UTC if no further regressions. Blocker: need someone to approve merging the rollback/kv fix into mainline — @sam can you review/approve after your tests?

sam: Will review and push approval in ~2 hours. Adding the unit test now. :+1:

kevin: I'll reserve the canary window and post a short note in eng-releases. If anything slips, ping me and I'll expand the window.

joel: Thanks all — leaving follow-ups in the ticket: https://issues.redwood.internal/RED-1452. If anyone sees unexpected diffs in promptset splits, drop them here. :mag:

rachel: confirmed logs and smoke look clean. marking staging -> ready for canary. :thumbsup:
